description: An original, jurisdiction-neutral lighting scheduled preventive maintenance service record for an indoor, exterior, emergency, or egress lighting system whose fixtures, circuits, supports, controls, illumination, and electrical condition must be traceable. It connects facility identity, asset-specific evidence, hazards, qualified decisions, exceptions, service status, and accountable closeout without replacing employer procedures or trade judgment.

blocks.label: Record reference and timing
Facility, location, and responsible parties

blocks.guidance: This Lighting record organizes facts and evidence. It does not replace employer energy-control procedures, permits, manufacturer instructions, required inspection, emergency response, or qualified trade judgment. Stop and route any unsafe or uncertain condition.

blocks.guidance: Check only directly observed or source-supported items; explain inaccessible, not applicable, or conflicting evidence below.
items: Zone, circuit, panel, control, fixture, and served-area identities reconcile

Lamp, LED module, driver, ballast, socket, connector, and wiring condition are recorded

Occupancy sensor, timer, photocell, dimmer, relay, contactor, and BAS status are reconciled
Emergency unit, exit sign, battery, charger, indicator, and transfer evidence is linked
Illumination complaint, dark area, glare, color, flicker, and task impact are recorded
Water intrusion, condensation, corrosion, dirt, insect, and environmental exposure are documented
Ladder, lift, ceiling, overhead, traffic, and falling-object access conditions are controlled
Lamp and material type, compatibility, disposal, and replacement evidence are recorded
Open circuit, fixture, emergency-lighting, and occupant-impact deficiencies are assigned

blocks.guidance: A checked condition requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.
items: Exposed live parts, arcing, burning, smoke, melted insulation, or severe heat is present
Wet electrical equipment, water intrusion, condensation, or conductive contamination is unresolved
Fixture, lens, support, pole, mast arm, ceiling, or mounting could fall or detach
Emergency, exit, stair, life-safety, or required egress illumination may be unavailable
Ladder, lift, ceiling, traffic, roof, weather, or overhead-work access is unsafe
Hazardous-location, voltage, lamp, driver, ballast, or control compatibility is uncertain
Required de-energization, lockout, qualified electrical work, or outage authorization is absent
Field status conflicts with circuit schedules, controls, test records, or emergency-power evidence
